description: Department of Labour - The Cost of Living Index Number for the Month of August 2015 applicable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing  Trade is 181.9 and the Special Allowance payable in respect of a normal working day in the Month of September will be Rs. 564.20
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and the calculation of a special allowance for workers, as mandated by the Wages Boards Ordinance. The core of the notification is the implementation of a regulatory framework (the Ordinance) and the publication of a statutory instrument (the index number and resulting allowance). This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette, which includes "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While a government official is named, the notice is not about their appointment or the structure of their ministry; it is about the execution of a specific regulatory function under an existing law.
